privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1_text: The personal data operator is {operator}. Contact us: {contact}.
privacy.s2_text: Name and Telegram account (if the child logs in with Telegram), login (if they log in with a code), grade, topics the child studied, answers to check questions, points, level and day streak, look and language settings, parent–child and teacher–student links, and the consent log.
privacy.s3_text: Photos of tasks are not stored: a photo is used for one explanation only and is removed from memory right away. We don't collect location, contacts, photos or videos from the device.
privacy.s4_text: To explain topics step by step, save progress, show parents reports and teachers class mistake statistics. Data is never sold or used for advertising.
privacy.s5_text: A child can start learning only after a parent gives consent in the Telegram bot. We record who gave consent, when, and to which version of this policy. If the policy changes, we ask for consent again.
privacy.s6_text: The text of the question and the photo of the task are sent to Google Gemini, which writes the explanation. Google's servers may be located outside the child's country. The child's name, login and progress are not sent to Google.
privacy.s7_title: Where and how long data is kept
privacy.s7_text: Data is stored on servers in: {location}. We keep it while the account exists. Backups are kept for no longer than 14 days.
privacy.s8_text: A parent can delete all of the child's data at any time: in the bot open “Profile” → “Delete data”. You can also request a copy of the data or ask a question using the contacts above.
privacy.s9_text: Logging in to the site is protected by a Telegram signature or a code, the connection is encrypted (HTTPS), and login attempts are limited. Login codes are stored only as hashes.
